# brethof-llms-txt

> A tool that generates and maintains an llms.txt file for a GitHub repository from its README and documentation.

It runs on Python 3.11+ using only the standard library. It can be used as a GitHub App, a GitHub Action, or from the command line. The tool structures the file based on docs navigation and uses a model to write descriptions.

## Docs

- [brethof-llms-txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-llms-txt/main/README.md): Generates and maintains llms.txt files from repository documentation, using deterministic structure and optional AI-written descriptions.
- [Privacy policy: Brethof llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-llms-txt/main/PRIVACY.md): Explains data handling, permissions, and model usage for the Brethof llms.txt GitHub App, distinguishing free and paid plans.
- [Terms of service: Brethof llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-llms-txt/main/TERMS.md): Defines service scope, repository ownership, AI text responsibility, and plan limitations for the Brethof llms.txt GitHub App.
- [How the GitHub App works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-llms-txt/main/docs/github-app.md): Explains how the GitHub App creates, updates, and manages llms.txt files via pull requests and scheduled runs.

## Examples

- [Examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-llms-txt/main/examples/README.md): Shows real generator output for Linux kernel, pgvector, and ChatGLM3, plus the GitHub Action workflow configuration file.
